senses.gloss:
Tvaṣṭā
(‘the shaper’)
------------------------------------------
According to the Ṛgveda (1.20.6), त्वष्टा is an artisan of the gods. Later, he is identified with विश्वकर्म (vide Viṣṇupurāṇa 3.2.11).
He is counted among the twelve Ādityas born to the sage कश्यप in अदिति.
Racanā, the daughter of प्रह्लाद, was his wife.
Triśiras or विश्वरूप was his son who had been chosen by इन्द्र to be the priest of the gods (See VIŚVARŪPA for details.). He was ultimately killed by इन्द्र.
Saṁjñā, the eldest wife of सूर्य (the Sun-god) was his daughter.
